map.每 1 茶匙泡打粉 ≈ 1/4 茶匙小苏打 + 1/2 茶匙塔塔粉（或等量酸奶/: Per 1 tsp baking powder ≈ 1/4 tsp baking soda + 1/2 tsp cream of tartar (or equal yogurt / lemon juice replacing part of the acidic liquid); halve the baking soda to avoid alkaline taste, and activate with acidic ingredient.
map.多数不等比。如黄油→植物油约 0.8 倍量、泡打粉→小苏打约 1/4 量，需结合: Most are not equal-ratio. E.g. butter → vegetable oil about 0.8×, baking powder → baking soda about 1/4×; consider recipe and acid-base balance; the tool gives common approximations.
map.过敏替代要注意什么？: What to watch in allergy substitution?
map.确认交叉过敏源（如坚果油、乳制品残留），素食替代注意隐藏动物成分（如明胶、鱼露）: Confirm cross allergens (nut oils, dairy residues); for vegetarian substitution watch hidden animal ingredients (gelatin, fish sauce); label when necessary to avoid accidental eating.
map.通常会。如植物油替黄油少了奶香与起酥感，牛奶替淡奶油稀了些；属风味/质地取舍，按: Usually yes. E.g. vegetable oil for butter loses the milky aroma and flakiness; milk for heavy cream is thinner; it is a flavor/texture trade-off, choose by dish tolerance.
